📒 Discovery notes

Click a tower, fog or planet, then «Add to notes» — each adds one line here.
    This browser blocks storage, so notes disappear on reload. Download them to keep them.
    Atomic structure
    Concept sketch — not the real atomic spacing or arrangement
    New here? Start here
    1. Rotate — drag to turn the island; zoom with the wheel (two fingers on a phone).
    2. Pick a property — choose a property in the chips above and the towers and fog change. A taller tower means we collected more values; fog marks a cell with no value yet (not collected yet, not «does not exist»).
    3. Click — click a tower or fog to see the source sentence and DOI. Try the quests below too.
    New in version 2
    1. Property planet — when you pick a property, a glowing planet rises above the island. Light beams run to the towers that have values; more values = thicker and brighter. Click the planet for the top 5 values.
    2. 📒 Discovery notes — use «Add to notes» in each panel to collect what you saw, one line at a time, and download it as a text file.
    3. View atomic structure — in a composition panel, click it to rotate a simple sketch of that MXene's layer stacking.
